name: God's Promises

provenance.detail: No named sermon playlist contains this message. It appears only in Watch Messages, so it stays Standalone Sunday.
Steve says, “This morning, I have what we call a standalone message for you.”

description: Steve shows that while people break their promises, God never does, and every promise of God is yes in Jesus Christ.
note: Steve introduces this as a standalone message.

provenance.detail: The YouTube title is God's Promises.
